name: esm-entry-guard
wrongPattern: An ESM CLI decides 'am I the entry point?' by comparing import.meta.url with a file:// URL built from the RAW process.argv[1]. Node resolves symlinks for import.meta.url but not for argv[1], so through any symlinked path (macOS /tmp -> /private/tmp, a linked skills dir, a bin shim) the guard is false, main() never runs, and the process prints nothing and exits 0 - a silent PASS for a gate or validator.
correctPattern: function isMain() { try { return Boolean(process.argv[1]) && realpathSync(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url); } catch { return false; } } - resolve argv[1] with realpathSync before comparing, and cover it with a test that spawns the script through a real symlink.
